name: plugin.agora_mcp_workbench
description: Agora Workbench MCP plugin providing sidecar lifecycle auditing, unified StateGraph workflow planning, Gateway/Dispatcher routing decisions, and Data Lake/v2 streaming transfer validation
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: agora_audit_sidecar
entrypoints.description: Validate a SidecarConfig and enforce SIDECAR_HOST/SIDECAR_PORT address locking and loopback containment

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Argument vector for the sidecar process

parameters.name: url_env_var
parameters.description: Environment variable exporting the sidecar base URL

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: TCP port assigned to the sidecar

parameters.name: use_env_python
parameters.description: Whether to prepend kernel environment Python

parameters.name: env_overrides
parameters.description: Caller env overrides inspected for SIDECAR_HOST/PORT override attempts

entrypoints.name: agora_plan_state_workflow
entrypoints.description: Validate synthetic BridgeEdge transitions and compute shortest BFS workflow path across StateGraph tools

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: Tool definitions with requires and produces lists

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Optional skill metadata entries checked for upstream duplication

entrypoints.name: agora_evaluate_connector
entrypoints.description: Evaluate GatewayServer policy cascades/rate limits or DispatcherServer worker selection

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Submitted code inspected by gateway allow/deny filters

parameters.name: session_affinity_worker
parameters.description: Sticky worker bound to the session

parameters.name: worker_failure_policy
parameters.description: Policy when affine worker is unhealthy ('reroute' or 'error')

entrypoints.name: agora_validate_datalake_transfer
entrypoints.description: Validate PolicyEnforcedCatalogProvider scope/cursor guards and bounded v2 streaming object transfer

parameters.name: has_per_artifact_enforcer
parameters.description: Whether a backend CatalogPolicyEnforcer was supplied

parameters.name: has_cursor
parameters.description: Whether a pagination continuation cursor was provided

parameters.name: target_source_permitted
parameters.description: Whether single-item get/resolve source is authorized

parameters.name: envelope_bytes
parameters.description: Encoded streaming metadata header size in bytes

parameters.name: has_duplicate_json_keys
parameters.description: Whether duplicate JSON keys exist in prefix/suffix envelope
